subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “In business class, students discussed convenience and hidden costs.”?
options: One student said online shopping made mistakes easier.
A student said the birds made the world feel connected.
One student said, "We did not do much."
They said they made the school look bad.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「In business class, students discussed convenience and hidden costs. One student said online shopping made mistakes easier.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「A student said the birds made the world feel connected.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「One student said, 'We did not do much.'」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「They said they made the school look bad.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「In business class, students discussed convenience and hidden costs. One student said online shopping made mistakes easier.」，答案為「One student said online shopping made mistakes easier.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「One student said online shopping made mistakes easier.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
